OP_XBG_DEPTH_BOUNDS	58	SetDepthBounds (VkPipelineDepthStencilStateCreateInfo depth bounds)	no: SetDepthBounds is a nop here (hle_nvn.c g_nops)

OP_XBG_TYPED_CLEAR	62	ClearColor with a scalar constant for integer-format targets (xbg_typed_clear)	no: ClearColori / ClearColorui are recorded as floats in OP_CLEAR_COLOR and converted per attachment type
OP_XBG_COPY_IMAGE_STRIDE	63	SetCopyImageStride (bytes per layer / depth slice)	no: we record it as OP_COPY_STRIDE with p_copy_stride.image = 1 (P5); the engine's own case for this op is dead code under our vocabulary
